svg.text: 1 Town square: spawn points, town clerk, board spot, pub (food and water), fountain, church, bus stop (taxi jobs)
2 Post office: job counter (parcel, fuel, taxi; benefit). Parcel drop at the house porch by the lock-up
3 Bank: two ATMs on the facade; vault door and cash bag on the east wall
4 General store counter; market stalls: universal trader, apple, plum, tomato, seeds
5 Car dealer lot (counter, showroom S105, three pads) and the garage
6 Police station: duty desk, fines desk, armory rack, whitelist desk; jail yard behind; escort car
7 Hospital: till and medicine cabinet. Fuel station: till and fuel-can job site
8 Org registry desk; side alley north to the hideout yard (door, machine, stash, contraband drop), back-room stall, fence
9 Contraband pickup at the barn out of town (dirt track east)
F Farm: orchard (apple, plum), tomato field and greenhouse, juicer at the barn
Q Quarry (mining area, furnace) and builders' yard (cement, gravel, sand)
L Forest edge: lumberjack, cuttable trees, sawmill
A Test annex (fenced): test runner, PR fixtures, legacy debug stations, test spawn ground
B Lock-up yard: the forced-entry (breach) gate

g.text: DebugWorld village (M1-25). 1 px = 0.45 m. North up, east right. Grid 50 m.
